Personality: Nuqar is a textbook Aserai opportunist, renowned on the battlefield for his remarkable boldness. Well-versed in polearms and horsemanship, and accomplished even in the use of siege engines, he is a rare and fierce commander within his house. Yet his sense of honor is thin; stopping at nothing to secure victory, he is widely regarded as a ruthless figure who excels at pressing an advantage and striking an enemy when they are down. Caring little for so-called mercy or generosity, he views warfare as a game of efficiency and results. Ruthlessly defending the interests of the Banu Hulyan clan, he exploits legal loopholes and family authority to consolidate his standing. Although sworn to Sultan Unqid, he cares far more about his clan's unshakeable dominance across the Nahasa desert than hollow moral codes—a pragmatic and slightly sinister character that allows him to navigate the complex politics of the Aserai with ease.
Background: Nuqar hails from the most illustrious house of the Aserai, the Banu Hulyan clan, which not only commands prosperous fiefs such as Quyaz and Sanala, but is also the royal house of the reigning Sultan Unqid. As a mainstay of his family, Nuqar witnessed the Aserai's transition from loose tribes into a sultanate. While Sultan Unqid maintains surface peace through charm and customary law, Nuqar plays the role of a hardline enforcer in the shadows. Knowing full well that his family's wealth stems from absolute control over oases and trade routes, he devotes himself to strengthening estate defenses through military force and engineering skill. Although outsiders criticize Unqid for indulging powerful houses that use bribery to squeeze the weak, Nuqar pays such talk no mind; alongside his wife Sila, he is raising their heir Razana to ensure that the clan remains firmly atop the pinnacle of power amid coming upheavals and continues to lead the dance of power across the Nahasa wastes.
